# WebCrawler.buzz

> Free web-based website crawler for SEO audits. Paste a URL, crawl every page, get structured data back. No signup required.

WebCrawler.buzz crawls any publicly accessible website using breadth-first search and returns structured SEO data for every discovered page: URL, page title, meta description, HTTP status code, response time, content type, page size, link counts, redirect destinations, and indexability. Results auto-expire after 1 hour. Full crawls can be exported as CSV.

## Docs

- [Home](https://webcrawler.buzz): Paste a URL and start a crawl.
- [API documentation](https://webcrawler.buzz/api-docs-public): Full REST API reference with request/response schemas.
- [MCP server](https://webcrawler.buzz/mcp): Model Context Protocol integration for Claude, Cursor, Codex, and other AI agents.
- [About](https://webcrawler.buzz/about): Project background, tech stack, and open-source status.
- [Full details for LLMs](https://webcrawler.buzz/llms-full.txt): Extended docs including database schema and blog index.

## API

- [POST /api/crawl](https://api.webcrawler.buzz/api/crawl): Start a new crawl. Body `{ "url": "https://example.com" }`.
- [GET /api/crawl/:jobId/progress](https://api.webcrawler.buzz/api/crawl/JOB_ID/progress): Live progress for a running job.
- [GET /api/crawl/:jobId](https://api.webcrawler.buzz/api/crawl/JOB_ID): Paginated results for a completed job.
- [POST /api/crawl/:jobId/export](https://api.webcrawler.buzz/api/crawl/JOB_ID/export): Request a CSV export via email.
- [GET /api/health](https://webcrawler.buzz/api/health): Service health check.
- [GET /api/stats](https://webcrawler.buzz/api/stats): Public usage statistics.
